using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Ollama.Extensions;
using Moq;
using OllamaSharp;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Ollama.UnitTests.Extensions;

public class OllamaServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddOllamaTextEmbeddingGeneration_CallsGetServiceOllamaApiClient_FallbackScenario()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>());
        services.AddSingleton<IOllamaApiClient>(Mock.Of<IOllamaApiClient>());

        var mockOllamaClient = new Mock<OllamaApiClient>().Object;
        // Don't register keyed services or IOllamaApiClient as OllamaApiClient, so it falls back to GetService<OllamaApiClient>

        // Act & Assert
        var result = services.AddOllamaTextEmbeddingGeneration(ollamaClient: null);

        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Single(result);

        // Verify the factory was created and would call GetService<OllamaApiClient>
        var descriptor = Assert.Single(result);
        Assert.Equal(ServiceLifetime.Singleton, descriptor.Lifetime);

        // Build container to verify the service creation path exercises the GetService call
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var embeddingService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<Microsoft.Extensions.AI.ITextEmbeddingGenerationService<string, float>>(null!);

        Assert.NotNull(embeddingService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddOllamaTextEmbeddingGeneration_WithNonOllamaApiClientIOllamaApiClient_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>());
        services.AddSingleton<IOllamaApiClient>(new Mock<IOllamaApiClient>().Object); // Not OllamaApiClient

        // Act & Assert
        var result = services.AddOllamaTextEmbeddingGeneration(ollamaClient: null);
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        var exception = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(
            () => serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<Microsoft.Extensions.AI.ITextEmbeddingGenerationService<string, float>>(null!));
        
        Assert.Equal("No IOllamaApiClient implementations found in the service collection.", exception.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddOllamaTextEmbeddingGeneration_KeyedOllamaApiClient_TakesPrecedenceOverGetService()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>());
        var keyedClient = new Mock<OllamaApiClient>().Object;
        services.AddKeyedSingleton<OllamaApiClient>("test-key", keyedClient);
        services.AddSingleton<OllamaApiClient>(Mock.Of<OllamaApiClient>()); // This should NOT be used

        // Act
        var result = services.AddOllamaTextEmbeddingGeneration(ollamaClient: null, serviceId: "test-key");
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var embeddingService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<Microsoft.Extensions.AI.ITextEmbeddingGenerationService<string, float>>("test-key");

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(embeddingService);
    }
}
